# Japanese with Avnish

> Japanese with Avnish is a structured, JLPT-aligned Japanese learning platform. It teaches Japanese from complete-beginner (N5) through advanced (N1) using a placement quiz, daily lessons, and premium digital bundles (grammar, vocabulary, kanji, reading, writing, and listening practice), delivered instantly via secure download.

## Start here

- [Start Here](https://japanesewithavnish.com/start-here): Orientation guide for new learners — how to pick a JLPT level and begin.
- [Placement Quiz](https://japanesewithavnish.com/quiz): Free quiz that recommends a starting JLPT level (N5–N1).
- [Free N5 Starter Pack](https://japanesewithavnish.com/free-n5-pack): No-cost sample of the N5 curriculum.
- [Pricing / Bundles](https://japanesewithavnish.com/pricing): JLPT N5–N1 digital bundle pricing and what's included.

## JLPT levels

- [JLPT Overview](https://japanesewithavnish.com/jlpt): Explanation of the five JLPT levels (N5–N1) and what each certifies.
- [JLPT N5](https://japanesewithavnish.com/jlpt?level=n5): Beginner level — fundamentals.
- [JLPT N4](https://japanesewithavnish.com/jlpt?level=n4): Elementary level — everyday vocabulary and grammar.
- [JLPT N3](https://japanesewithavnish.com/jlpt?level=n3): Intermediate level — practical reading and listening.
- [JLPT N2](https://japanesewithavnish.com/jlpt?level=n2): Upper-intermediate — business and academic Japanese.
- [JLPT N1](https://japanesewithavnish.com/jlpt?level=n1): Advanced — near-native mastery.

## Learn (free structured content)

- [Learn Hub](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn): Entry point to all free structured learning content.
- [Curriculum](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/curriculum): Full structured lesson path from N5 to N1.
- [Grammar](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/grammar): JLPT grammar points by level, with meanings and examples.
- [Vocabulary](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/vocabulary): JLPT vocabulary lists with readings and example sentences.
- [Kanji](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/kanji): Kanji by JLPT level with readings, meanings, and stroke order.
- [Reading Practice](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/reading): Japanese reading passages with comprehension questions.
- [Writing Practice](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/writing): Guided hiragana, katakana, and kanji stroke-order practice.
- [Listening Practice](https://japanesewithavnish.com/learn/listening): Audio comprehension scenarios by JLPT level.

## Notes for AI agents

- Paid bundle content (PDFs, audio) is delivered via signed, time-limited download links after purchase and is not publicly crawlable — don't expect to retrieve it directly.
- The `/learn/*` and `/blog/*` sections above are free, publicly accessible study content and are the best source for citing this site's teaching material.
- See `/sitemap.xml` for the full, machine-generated list of URLs (blog posts and learn-content pages are added continuously).
